_about: Facts taken from the repository's recorded evidence (docs/LAB.md, docs/STATUS.md). This file is the only non-sample data source of the console when no engine is connected. Edit it only together with the evidence it cites.
release: v0.1.0 published; v0.2.0 prepared, not tagged
maturity_note: Observe-only use is supported. Applying changes is for a supervised pilot. Not validated for unattended production.

modes.name: Observe-only
modes.detail: Chart default (operator.observeOnly=true). Measures, recommends and reports. Writes nothing to the cluster.

modes.name: Assisted
modes.detail: Opt-in applier. Every change needs a human approval of the exact recommendation; the approver cannot be the publisher. Automatic rollback.

modes.name: Automated
modes.detail: Off by default. Needs requireApproval: false in the policy, inside allowed namespaces, bounds, windows and rate limits. Not validated on real traffic over weeks.

providers.name: GKE
passed: node matching on real FOCUS rows (one day)
pending: saving reconciled with an invoice (the account is on credits)

providers.name: AWS / EKS
providers.evidence: Not part of this phase. No AWS integration is offered.

savings.detail: Every recommendation: requests delta x unit price. Nothing applied.
Applied and kept changes (rightsize report, operator outcome metrics). No cost measured.

GKE: 0.067 USD/h less at list price (one of three nodes released, two 20-minute windows). AKS: 0.096 USD/h less at list price (one of two nodes released). Trivial test workloads; list price, not invoices.
No saving has been reconciled with a provider invoice yet. The tool exists (rightsize reconcile); it needs two billing exports of equivalent periods.

tests.where: local Windows run without -race; CI runs -race, envtest and kind e2e

known_gaps: Recommender defaults are not tuned on weeks of real traffic
KubeCostAutoscaler accepts spec.predictive, spec.oomProtection and spec.nodeBinPacking but does not implement them (reported in status)
Node optimisation is a read-only analysis: nothing drains, cordons or deletes nodes for consolidation
No multi-cluster control plane: one operator per cluster
No billing or licence enforcement is implemented
